cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: broad selling, 3% of AI names green
cards.body: SPX -3.70% · BTC -8.91% · Gold -4.62% · Nasdaq100 -5.61%. At the last close, 3% of 111 AI names were green — broad selling. AI Platforms, Internet & AdTech did the heavy lifting at -3.10%.

cards.headline: AI Platforms, Internet & AdTech leads, AI Chips & Compute lags
cards.body: Strongest AI sector is AI Platforms, Internet & AdTech at -3.10%; weakest is AI Chips & Compute at -12.26%. Rotation within the AI trade, not a one-way move.

cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: SpaceX (SPCX) -7.69% at $127.79

cards.headline: INTU moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: INTU is -12.77% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.

cards.headline: Risk: AI bubble index 42 — Neutral
cards.body: The composite AI Bubble Index sits at 42/100, led by Market Concentration at 61. Higher = frothier; the risk is everyone caring at once while valuations are already stretched.
